# thalassa_containerregistry_namespace_configuration (Data Source)

Get configuration for a container registry namespace



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace_id` (String) Identity of the container registry namespace

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the namespace. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `id` (String) Identity of the namespace this configuration belongs to
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the configuration
- `retention_policy` (List of Object) Retention policy for the namespace (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention_policy))
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)
- `visibility` (String) Visibility of the namespace

<a id="nestedatt--retention_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_policy`

Read-Only:

- `delete_untagged_images` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `rules` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--retention_policy--rules))

<a id="nestedobjatt--retention_policy--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_policy.rules`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number)
- `days` (Number)
- `days_since_created` (Number)
- `days_since_pulled` (Number)
- `repository_patterns` (List of String)
- `scope` (String)
- `tag_patterns` (List of String)
